description: The public endpoint defaults to format=json and textMode=compatible: the complete compact source graph is delivered once as JSON in content[0].text (96KiB whole-body cap), with a small wiki-bank-case-text/1 transport receipt in structuredContent. Text-only clients receive all native material except derived Markdown. Explicit summary puts the graph in structuredContent and only a notice in TextContent; use it only if your client consumes structuredContent. Explicit full preserves the previous full shape, up to2MiB. Internal callers without a boundary policy retain full compatible output. Compact overflow is held whole and offers a manual fresh-read full retry if your client accepts the larger response. Neither byte cap guarantees a model token limit. No material is truncated. The complaint desk's deterministic assessment for a frozen account, a closure notice, a document request, a stuck payment or a refused application: what to do now, the escalation ladder of the bank's jurisdiction (bank complaint, ombudsman or regulator, data access request), with recorded requirements, unresolved conditions and primary-source links, plus recorded response periods, cautions and the help that fits. Also returns the letters to send — the formal complaint and the data access request, in English with bracketed placeholders the person fills in themselves. The reported stage is an unverified intake fact; it does not establish completed steps or eligibility. No personal dates are calculated. calendarStatus explains the missing inputs. UK/EU complaint-response rules are returned separately as statutoryReply; the intake does not establish their applicable branch or a statutory due date. Pass holder whenever it is known: an ombudsman's door depends on whose account it is. Information, not legal advice. Never submit a person's contact details; hand them the complaint URL instead.

format.description: Optional. Public HTTP default json selects wiki-bank-case-compact/1, preserving all native material except derived Markdown in a full-source graph, up to96KiB whole body. Explicit full retains the previous full DTO including Markdown and defaults to compatible text, up to2MiB. Direct/internal callers without a boundary policy retain full. No protocol-based selection or universal token-limit guarantee.

holder.description: Whose account it is. Optional; without it eligibility is stated, not decided.

jurisdiction.description: Where the bank or the neobank's licence sits.

sanctions.description: Russia or Belarus nexus of the client.

textMode.description: Optional, default compatible. For json, compatible delivers one complete wiki-bank-case-compact/1 JSON graph in content[0].text and a small wiki-bank-case-text/1 transport receipt in structuredContent; validate its text bytes/hash and decode the graph before using sources. summary requires selected format=json and a client that consumes structuredContent; TextContent is only a notice. Explicit full+compatible retains the previous full DTO in both fields and may be large. Direct/internal defaults remain compatible.

today.description: Optional reference date (YYYY-MM-DD), retained for compatibility. It does not establish receipt of a complaint, the applicable procedure, eligibility or a personal due date.

name: assess_bank_case

provenance.description: Origin of one record: stable id, clean canonical URL, publisher, the exact published revision served, a ready citation, primary sources and review status.

id.description: <locale>:<slug> for an article, <dataset>:<record id> for a dataset row.

version.description: Revision of exactly the material served: for an article the snapshot content hash (the HTML ETag value); for a dataset record the dataset revision it was published in, not the published filename. Null when unknown.

reportedStage.description: Stage reported by the caller, not a verified procedural event or eligibility finding.

statutoryReply.description: UK/EU whole native complaint-reply cell with all conditions, caveats and quotations. Personal scope and statutory due date remain unknown. Null outside this cohort.

payload.description: Original native material except derived nativeContextMarkdown. Only object occurrences in sources arrays become { $wikiBankSource: id }. Resolve complete source objects from sourcesById before inspecting citations or verifying native owner byte hashes. Preserve order and repeated occurrences.

sourcesById.description: Complete source objects keyed by canonical full-object SHA plus exact JSON wire SHA. Qualifications, translations, locators, unknown fields and property order participate in identity.

title: Assess a problem with a bank
